en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the ornate corner façade of a bookshop with large display windows, signage reading "Ulrich Moser's Buchhandlung J. Meyerhoff" and the street number 23. Several people stand on the sidewalk near a gas lamp. Beneath the image is printed "Graz, den .... 190" with space to fill in the date. At the bottom is a caption naming the bookshop, and there is a purple archival stamp dated 1902.
